wants.topic: Tribal/regional freedom fighters forgotten by mainstream history (Birsa Munda, Sidho-Kanho, Tilka Manjhi, etc.)
wants.evidence: DARK DISOM's Birsa Munda video 730x normal, Hul Maha 304x, Tilka Manjhi 19x — by far the highest multipliers in dataset

wants.topic: Indian forts/temples with active treasure mysteries and unresolved archaeological questions
wants.evidence: The India Story: Taragarh fort treasure 67x, Son Bhandar cave 7.7x; AG FACT: El Dorado-style lost gold 65x, desert gold coffin 119x

wants.topic: Modern-era saints/gurus with documented miracles and living memory (Neem Karoli Baba, etc.)
wants.evidence: Gyanwood's Neem Karoli Baba 23x normal (4M views), vastly outperforming ancient temple docs (Badrinath 3.8x, Rameswaram 3.6x)

wants.topic: Travelogues linking foreign locations to Indian/Islamic heritage (Jeddah gateway to Makkah, Hong Kong/China Islamic history)
wants.evidence: info ka godaam: Jeddah 4.3x, Hong Kong 11.9x, China 4.6x — all Urdu/Hindi, history+travel+heritage angle

wants.topic: Historical crimes/heists/robberies with dramatic storytelling (1925 Devgarh train robbery)
wants.evidence: The India Story: 1925 black night train robbery 14x normal — specific year, dramatic event, royalty + bandits

wants.topic: Ram Setu / Ramayana geography treated as historical investigation not just devotion
wants.evidence: Gyanwood Rameswaram+Ram Setu 3.6x; Khatu Shyam (pure devotion) 0.04x — audience wants evidence/mystery angle

gaps: Deep dives on lesser-known tribal revolts (Santhal, Bhil, Kol, Gond, Munda) beyond Birsa Munda — viewers ask "cover X leader next" in comments on such videos
Forensic/archaeological breakdowns of specific treasure legends ("has anyone actually excavated X?" "show the ground-penetrating radar")
Family trees and living descendants of forgotten rulers/warriors — "find their vanshavali" requests
Step-by-step travel guides to historical sites featured ("how to reach", "where to stay", "permissions needed")
Debunking vs. validating popular myths with primary sources (farmans, copper plates, travelogues) — "show the original document"
saturated: Generic temple documentaries without mystery/investigation angle (Khatu Shyam 0.04x, Great Wall 0.03x)
Pure science/tech/future topics (AI, nuclear, potato history, Shilajit) — all <0.3x
International history without Indian/Islamic connection (Venice engineering 0.05x, Syria 0.17x)
Well-covered mainstream freedom fighters (Gandhi, Bhagat Singh, Netaji) — no data but implied by tribal outperformance
Listicle "top 10 mysteries" formats — outperformed by single-deep-dive narratives
